newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: NEW CARGO AIRLINE JOINS GROWING ZIMBABWE INDUSTRY.
newsitem.headline: NEW CARGO AIRLINE JOINS GROWING ZIMBABWE INDUSTRY.

text.p: A consortium of Zimbabwean businessmen has set up a new cargo airline in partnership with a Russian firm, the state-owned Business Herald newspaper reported on Thursday.
"Flywell (Airlines Pvt Ltd) is a product of two years of hard work and we have a good chance of making it," the airline's executive chairman Forbes Magadu told the paper.
Magadu said the company's first aircraft arrived in Zimbabwe last week and was already transporting a wide variety of cargo within east and southern Africa.

"We already have contracts in countries such as South Africa, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Kenya and we think we have made a good start," Magadu told the paper, adding that the airline planned to venture further afield later.
He was unavailable for further comment.
Flywell joins a growing industry in Zimbabwe were some 15 cargo airlines have broken a monopoly formerly held by state-owned Affretair.
